description: Cruiser fills the frame. Tests silhouette, panel density, rim light and material identity. HUD suppressed: this is a look-review frame.
setup: const t = N.world.systems.tactical; t.mode='LOCKED'; t.lockTarget = N.world.player; t.yaw = t._yawTarget = 2.35; t.pitchOffset = t._pitchTarget = 0.18; t.zoomT = t._zoomTTarget = 0.02;

description: Mid tactical range, raking key. The everyday playing view. HUD suppressed: this is a look-review frame.
setup: const t = N.world.systems.tactical; t.mode='LOCKED'; t.lockTarget = N.world.player; t.yaw = t._yawTarget = 0.9; t.pitchOffset = t._pitchTarget = 0.30; t.zoomT = t._zoomTTarget = 0.26;

description: Maximum tactical zoom. Cruiser a bright speck against the gas giant. The shot that sells the game.
setup: const t = N.world.systems.tactical; t.mode='LOCKED'; t.lockTarget = N.world.player; t.yaw = t._yawTarget = 1.7; t.pitchOffset = t._pitchTarget = 0.22; t.zoomT = t._zoomTTarget = 0.86;

description: Chase camera. Tests the cinematic framing and the sense of mass.
Cruiser under way with hostiles on the plane. Tests scale cues and the fight read.
setup: const w = N.world; const t = w.systems.tactical; t.mode='LOCKED'; t.lockTarget = w.player; t.yaw = t._yawTarget = 0.4; t.pitchOffset = t._pitchTarget = 0.42; t.zoomT = t._zoomTTarget = 0.48; const foe = w.ships.find(s => s !== w.player && !s.dead); if (foe) { w.player.orderAttack(foe); foe.orderAttack(w.player); }

description: Close pose WITH the interface up. The occlusion frame: diff it against `close` to measure what share of the hull the chrome is standing on.
setup: const t = N.world.systems.tactical; t.mode='LOCKED'; t.lockTarget = N.world.player; t.yaw = t._yawTarget = 2.35; t.pitchOffset = t._pitchTarget = 0.18; t.zoomT = t._zoomTTarget = 0.02;

description: The everyday playing view WITH the interface up. This is the frame the HUD-occludes-the-ship finding was measured on.
setup: const t = N.world.systems.tactical; t.mode='LOCKED'; t.lockTarget = N.world.player; t.yaw = t._yawTarget = 0.9; t.pitchOffset = t._pitchTarget = 0.30; t.zoomT = t._zoomTTarget = 0.26;

description: Fight, interface up, hostiles on the plane. Tests the target block and the world-anchored label chips over a lit backdrop.
setup: const w = N.world; const t = w.systems.tactical; t.mode='LOCKED'; t.lockTarget = w.player; t.yaw = t._yawTarget = 0.4; t.pitchOffset = t._pitchTarget = 0.42; t.zoomT = t._zoomTTarget = 0.48; const foe = w.ships.find(s => s !== w.player && !s.dead); if (foe) { w.player.orderAttack(foe); foe.orderAttack(w.player); }
